thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 02/05/2019: GLUU, ALLT, STX, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 02/05/2019: GLUU, ALLT, STX, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.30%
AAPL: +0.95%
IBM: Flat
CSCO: +0.17%
GOOG: -1.38%
Most technology stocks were advancing pre-market Tuesday.
Early movers include:
(-) Glu Mobile ( GLUU ), which was sinking by 10% as the company reported a Q4 net loss of a penny a share compared with the consensus on Capital IQ for a profit of $0.07, but that was narrower than the year ago loss of $0.29 a share.
(+) Allot Communications ( ALLT ) was up over 10% after booking Q4 adjusted net loss of $0.01 per share, compared to a net loss of $0.04 per share in the prior year period. The average Street estimate from three analysts was $0.03 loss per share.
(-) Seagate Technology ( STX ) was down more than 4% as it posted fiscal Q2 net income of $1.41 per share, compared with $1.48 per shre in the year-ago quarter. Analysts polled by Capital IQ were expecting EPS of $1.27.
